title: Retry production go-live deployment

requirements.text: Retry the production “go-live” deployment/push so the application finishes going live instead of remaining stuck on an endless loading state.
acceptanceCriteria: A new production go-live/push attempt is triggered after the user confirms.
The production deployment completes successfully and no longer remains stuck on “going live”/endless loading.
If the retry fails, the user is shown a clear failure outcome (error or status) instead of indefinite loading.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Implementing new application features unrelated to production deployment.
Changing the existing predictor UI/logic (e.g., category visibility fixes) unless required to address the deployment retry behavior.
